observations.claim: Actual Codex enforced configured tool timeout.

retained_failures.observation: Initial model instruction used unsupported state completed. Tool returned invalid_condition before interruption. Not cancellation evidence.
Probe timed out waiting for tool start while account plugin startup was active. Retained TimeoutError. Final probes disable plugins and apps explicitly.
Fresh Codex process collided with active numeric request ID under the earlier stateless implementation. This observed product failure motivated durable session isolation.
Raw JSON capture was written, then temporary-directory cleanup raised Directory not empty in the invoking tool output. Final driver terminates its own process group and bounds reader shutdown.
